core_insights.title: One weakness, many stages
core_insights.headline: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor (CWE-200) underlies 5 of 40 CVEs and reaches 7 of 8 tactic subtrees. Ranked one by one they read as separate findings; the tree groups them under one recurring weakness.

facts.label: Tactic subtrees
facts.value: 7 of 8 (Reconnaissance, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion, Credential Access, Discovery, Lateral Movement)

facts.label: Same for all of them
facts.value: attack complexity LOW, privileges required NONE, user interaction NONE

core_insights.title: Path count is not CVE count
core_insights.headline: Defense Evasion has 19 paths from 8 CVEs, while Lateral Movement has 4 paths from 7 CVEs. Here CVE count tracks path count closely, so it is a fair proxy.

core_insights.title: Redundancy shows where one control helps twice
core_insights.headline: 50 CAPEC references collapse to 33 distinct patterns (34.0% repeat one already used in another tactic). The same mechanisms recur across stages, so one control can cut paths in several of them.

bars.label: T1574.006  Hijack Execution Flow: Dynamic Linker Hijacking
T1574.007  Hijack Execution Flow: Path Interception by PATH Environment Variable

core_insights.note: A control aimed at Hijack Execution Flow: Dynamic Linker Hijacking (T1574.006) would reach paths under Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Defense Evasion.

additional_insights.title: Where a fix removes the most paths
additional_insights.headline: Fixing CVE-2018-7847 alone removes 15 of 74 paths (20.3%), the most of any single CVE. It also has the highest base score.
additional_insights.note: A path is removed only when every CVE supporting it is fixed. Sets are the best of all combinations of that size (greedy for very large devices).

additional_insights.title: How easily the paths can be reached
additional_insights.headline: 74 of 74 paths (100.0%) can be driven remotely: at least one supporting CVE is reachable over the network with no privileges and no user interaction.

facts.label: Physical access is the only route

additional_insights.note: Taken from each CVE's CVSS metrics; a path counts at the easiest of its CVEs.

additional_insights.title: Which weakness feeds the most paths
additional_insights.headline: Exposure of Sensitive Information to an Unauthorized Actor (CWE-200) supports 33 of 74 paths (44.6%) from 5 CVEs.
